messages.subject: Bootstrapping w DSM in R
parts:
Hello all

I have been using the code generated by Distance in R to predict abundanc=
e of dall's porpoise off the coast of British Columbia. Because my data w=
as collected opportunistically it is zero-inflated. As such I decided to =
apply a tweedie distribution to the data by running the model in R direct=
ly - as this type of distribution is not offered in Distance yet.

I have managed to get the code to work all the way through to the varianc=
e code which does not appear to be running.

The code I have to date is:
